vacancy.title: Thermo-Mechanical Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Exceptionally strong technical match for TU Delft MSc Mechanical Engineering, Lunar Zebro thermal modelling and COMSOL/FEM, precision mechanism design and hands-on hardware. Designs and analyses thermo-mechanical spaceborne optical instruments from concept through assembly, integration and qualification. Sassenheim is near ESTEC but this is cosine employment, not an on-site ESA/ESTEC placement. Space instrument heritage is the main stretch; salary unspecified on official vacancy and should be checked against ~€70k threshold.
